tools.name: ads_creative_upload_media
tools.description: Upload a video or an image to the ad account's media library. Returns the media id and its status.

tools.name: ads_create_campaign
tools.description: Create a campaign. Arguments: ad_account_id, name, objective, status (ACTIVE or PAUSED), special_ad_categories.

tools.name: ads_create_adset
tools.description: Create an ad set. Arguments: ad_account_id, campaign_id, name, daily_budget or lifetime_budget, optimization_goal, promoted_object, targeting, status (ACTIVE or PAUSED).

tools.name: ads_create_creative
tools.description: Create an ad creative from a video, its thumbnail and copy. Arguments: ad_account_id, page_id, video_id, thumbnail, primary_texts, headlines, descriptions, call_to_action, link, self_ai_disclosure (OPT_IN or OPT_OUT).

tools.name: ads_create_ad
tools.description: Create an ad in an ad set from a creative. Arguments: ad_account_id, adset_id, creative_id, name, status (ACTIVE or PAUSED).

tools.name: ads_get_ad_entities
tools.description: Read campaigns, ad sets or ads with their status.

tools.name: ads_get_ad_preview
tools.description: A preview link of an ad.

tools.name: ads_activate_entity
tools.description: Switch a campaign, ad set or ad on (ACTIVE): it starts delivering and spending.
